text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — I'm consolidating the QBR slide slate today. Need final slide owners and any high-risk asks by 3pm PT. cc @Carol Barnes for exec alignment.
Adarsh Patel: I can take the infra health slide. Will add the latency trend and top 2 incidents.
Lina Gomez: I'll own onboarding metrics + plan. Quick ask — do we want to include NPS breakdown?
Mia Chen: Yes include NPS but keep it 1 slide, highlight cohort trends only.
Samir Khan: Putting myself down for renewal-risk heatmap. Need list of accounts with >2 open blockers.
Carol Barnes: Exec asks: 2 min summary per owner, highlight mitigations and asks from leadership. No new asks during the deck run.
Mia Chen: Noted. I'll make a "pending asks" slide for any cross-org needs so we can queue them after the exec readout.
Lina Gomez: Uploading draft slides to the QBR folder now — link: https://redwood.app/qbr/394-drafts 
Adarsh Patel: For the infra slide, I'm going to add a short blurb on Dedicated capacity usage and cost delta. Anyone object?
Samir Khan: fine by me. Also flagging two accounts: Harborline and Meridian — both have SLO deviation tickets. I'll paste details in thread.
Mia Chen: Paste incoming, thx. Also can someone run a quick check that the demo VM works for the live walkthrough? @deploy-bot can you confirm deploy status?
deploy-bot: deploy-check: production-demo-vm => healthy (last checked 12m ago). :white_check_mark:
Carol Barnes: Great. Mia — recommend we rehearse with execs at 4:15pm PT for a 12-minute dry run. Can you schedule?
Mia Chen: Scheduling 4:15 rehearsal. Sending calendar invite to owners now.
Lina Gomez: Uploaded slide 7 with onboarding funnel. Please review and send small edits in thread.
Adarsh Patel: Small edit on slide 3: replace chart with median p95 instead of mean. Done.
Samir Khan: Shared account list snippet:
```
Harborline — blocker: schema mismatch on embeddings ingestion (owner: Eng-Data)
Meridian — blocker: expired cert on private deployment (owner: Eng-Infra)
```
Mia Chen: Thanks. Samir — can you own follow-up with Eng-Infra and Eng-Data and drop short status lines in the deck by 2:45pm PT?
Samir Khan: Yes, will update by 2:30pm PT.
Carol Barnes: One more: make sure the "risk" slide has a recommended ask per account (e.g., "eng support for 48h" or "exec sponsor"), we want clear actionables.
Mia Chen: Will do. Final checklist for owners: 1) upload final slide 2) add 2-line exec summary 3) note any blockers and ask. Deadline: 3pm PT.
Adarsh Patel: Acknowledged.
Lina Gomez: Acknowledged.
Samir Khan: Acknowledged — will post follow-ups when I have eng responses.
Carol Barnes: Thanks team — see you at rehearsal. :rocket:
